# Captured source metadata

bitcoin-metadata.json retains historical Blockstream metadata and Bitcoin header
controls captured on October 4, 2026. Recovery tests use these responses offline;
this is not a product lookup receipt or a fresh provider observation.

The public copy omits development-run identifiers, cumulative installation usage
and stage bookkeeping. Provider observations, headers and test inputs are
unchanged. SHA256: 7b6fd363cee4d2982aaf28e5969815384ed6cf7c5d1c7d44f353853251ff11ea.

[Provenance fingerprints](../../../demo_results/public-example-provenance.json)
record the original capture fingerprint and the current public copy.
The tests check supplied header identities, proof-of-work targets, timestamp
linkage and median calculations; they do not independently validate Bitcoin consensus.
